questions.title: Which company will hold the record for the largest US IPO by a foreign firm as of July 10, 2026?
questions.background: Alibaba's 2014 US initial public offering raised $25 billion, setting the record for the largest US IPO by a foreign company.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official issuer announcements and contemporaneous reporting by reputable news organizations.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the company reported as holding the all-time record for the largest US initial public offering by a foreign company as of July 10, 2026. Compare offerings by proceeds raised, not company valuation. An offering whose pricing and share sales have been announced may qualify before exchange trading begins.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The company's commonly used name.

questions.title: Which company will be the world's most valuable publicly traded company by market capitalization on July 17, 2026?
questions.background: Market capitalization is the total market value of a company's outstanding shares.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the company identified as the world's most valuable by market capitalization in Al Jazeera's contemporaneous reporting on July 17, 2026.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-07-17
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the company's commonly used name.
questions.accepted_format: Answer with the company's commonly used name.

questions.title: Which broad demand component will contribute most to Japan's quarter-on-quarter GDP growth in April–June 2026?
questions.background: Japan's Cabinet Office publishes quarterly GDP estimates, including a breakdown of demand components' contributions to growth.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Cabinet Office's August 2026 release of Japan's April–June 2026 GDP estimates. Use that release's figures rather than subsequent revisions.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-17
  • Accepted Answer Format: Resolve to the top-level demand component with the largest percentage-point contribution to Japan's quarter-on-quarter GDP growth for April–June 2026. Answer with the component's standard name.
questions.accepted_format: Resolve to the top-level demand component with the largest percentage-point contribution to Japan's quarter-on-quarter GDP growth for April–June 2026. Answer with the component's standard name.

questions.title: Which humanoid robot will win the opening-day 100-metre race at the 2026 World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing?
questions.background: The World Humanoid Robot Games includes sporting competitions for humanoid robots.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official results or contemporaneous reporting of the opening-day 100-metre race at the 2026 World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-22
  • Accepted Answer Format: String (robot name). Resolve to the humanoid robot reported as the winner of the opening-day 100-metre race.
questions.accepted_format: String (robot name). Resolve to the humanoid robot reported as the winner of the opening-day 100-metre race.

questions.title: Which commodity category will record the largest monthly percentage price increase in the FAO Food Price Index for August 2026?
questions.background: The UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) publishes a monthly index tracking international prices across major food commodity categories.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Resolve to the commodity category with the largest percentage price increase from July to August 2026, as reported in the FAO's September 2026 Food Price Index release.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-04
  • Answer with the category name.
questions.accepted_format:
• Resolve to the commodity category with the largest percentage price increase from July to August 2026, as reported in the FAO's September 2026 Food Price Index release.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-04
  • Answer with the category name.

questions.title: Which country will be the first in 2026 to publicly acknowledge deploying purpose-built weapons in Earth orbit?
questions.background: Military satellites provide communications, navigation and intelligence services. Deploying weapons in orbit could significantly change how countries protect or threaten these systems.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public statements by national governments or military officials, corroborated by reliable international news reporting.
  • Qualifying Event: Resolve to the country whose government or military first publicly acknowledges during 2026 that it has already deployed purpose-built weapons in Earth orbit. Merely describing satellites with potential military applications, announcing future deployments, or confirming ground-based anti-satellite weapons does not qualify.
  • Resolution Timing: Resolve on the date of the first qualifying public acknowledgment, provided it occurs by December 31, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's commonly used English name.
questions.accepted_format: The country's commonly used English name.
